name: Hello World
summary:
Hello World is a free VR experience designed to showcase the power of hand tracking and immersive interaction in industrial environments.

Step into a manufacturing simulation where you can explore and interact with real-world machinery — all without controllers. From operating a scissor lift and forklift to inspecting a toolbox, robotic arm, and concrete pump, each interaction is designed to highlight the precision and intuitiveness of VR hand tracking.
